via.name: Signposted junction about 130 m along the Low-Level Track
via.quote: the signposted junction about 130 m along the Low-Level Track

evidence: The Pylon Peak Summit Track is accessed from the Low-Level Track, which starts at the carpark at the end of Waiorongomai Valley Road.
After around 2 hour 30 min, you reach the junction with the North South Track.
From here, return down the Pylon Peak Summit Track the way you came.

ways.label: Loop alternative via the North South Track and Waiorongomai Valley

start.name: Carpark at the end of Waiorongomai Valley Road

end.name: Carpark at the end of Waiorongomai Valley Road

via.name: Junction with the North South Track
via.quote: the junction with the North South Track

evidence: You can take a loop by following the North South Track, Waipapa Track/Crimson Thread Track and Waiorongomai Valley tracks.
From the junction of the Pylon Peak Summit Track and the North South Track, take the left-hand branch of the North South Track and follow it along the Kaimai range (towards Mt Te Aroha).
Follow this track as it descends to the Waiorongomai Saddle.

From the saddle, turn off the ridge and descend into Waiorongomai Valley on the Te Aroha Link track. Follow the signposts to return back to the car park (there are various track options through Waiorongomai Valley).

doubts: The page is named 'Summit Loop' and DOC's distance gives both '4.4 km to the summit' and '13.7 km loop', but the text presents the return-the-same-way summit walk as the walk and the loop as an 'alternative (more advanced and longer option)', so the out-and-back is main. DOC's '6-7 hr' is not clearly tied to either way, so times are null (the loop is '4-5 hours from the junction with the North South Track' plus about 2 hr 30 min up). The turnaround is the North South Track junction (the text implies it is at the summit ridge); no entry matches it. T2 'Pylon Peak Track' taken as the Pylon Peak Summit Track. The Low-Level Track has no names entry (F1 calls it Low Level Drive Track).
